entity: Groupon, Inc. — US employing entity (to confirm)
summary: No statutory vacation in New York, but NYC's Earned Safe and Sick Time Act gives 1 hour per 30 worked, up to 56 hours a year for employers with 100+ staff, usable from day one, carried over, never paid out. Since 22 February 2026 it also adds 32 unpaid hours, and New York gives 20 hours of paid prenatal leave.

owner.role: Employment counsel (US) + People Ops New York

locationAssumption.citation: NYC Admin Code title 20, ch. 8 (Earned Safe and Sick Time Act) applies to employees working in New York City; New York State Labor Law §196-b runs alongside it

rule.citation: Leave is taken in hours of the scheduled shift
rule.note: Federal and state law set no counting rule for company PTO.

source.note: Calendar is a placeholder (no public Groupon US holiday list exists); all dates match OPM federal holiday observance rules.

rule.citation: Company holidays are paid days off outside the leave banks (policy assumption)
No statutory vacation entitlement: paid time off is company policy. Groupon's own Dallas posting describes "flexible PTO"
rule.note: Modelled as flexible PTO with no statutory floor; the statutory minimum is zero.

rule.citation: Flexible PTO: no accrual, usage tracked, no balance limit (company policy)
Flexible PTO has no balance to carry
Illness during PTO can be charged to protected sick time instead
New York: unused vacation is forfeited on separation only if the written policy says so
rule.note: Statute text (Labor Law §198-c / §195(5)) and case law not checked; counsel to confirm.

buckets.label: NYC paid safe and sick time

rule.citation: NYC Admin Code §20-913(b): 1 hour per 30 hours worked; employers with 100 or more employees need not provide more than 56 hours a year; no waiting period
NYC Admin Code §20-913(b): accrues per hours worked from the first day (front-loading 56 hours is the alternative)
NYC Admin Code §20-913(h): unused time carries over (up to 56 hours), but use may be limited to 56 hours a year
Not applicable to the sick bank
NYC Admin Code §20-913(i): unused safe and sick time is not paid out on separation

extras.label: Unpaid protected time (2026)
extras.citation: NYC Local Law 145 of 2025 (in force 22 February 2026): 32 hours of unpaid protected time off, available immediately and refreshed each calendar year
extras.note: Not modelled as a bucket. DCWP's final rules took effect 23 July 2026.

extras.label: Paid prenatal leave
extras.citation: New York Labor Law §196-b (from 1 Jan 2025): 20 hours of paid prenatal leave per 52 weeks, available from hire, no carry-over, no payout

extras.label: New York State sick leave
extras.citation: New York Labor Law §196-b: 56 hours of paid sick leave for employers with 100+ employees, carried over, with use limited to 56 hours a year
extras.note: Runs concurrently with the NYC bank.
